items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: Oh man, him and I used to kick it back, man.

ctx.x: Did the white musicians come in and mix it up then? Yes, indeed man. They always did that, huh? Always did that. Musicians always wanted to play together, didn't they?

It didn't make no difference. What? This boy named Ross Bonet? Mm-hmm. Oh man, him and I used to kick it back, man. What did he play? General Sykes, man. That's one of your greatest Sykes, wrong place.
Ross Bonet? Sure. I thought he was governor of Mississippi.
